t: r/BuyItForLife on Reddit: What are the must buy home essentials you would suggest to a couple who are setting their first home together. Thanks in advance!
s: September 12, 2023 - I asked friends and family for bits they didn't need and went to charity shops and 100% furnished my home with used, "placeholder" furniture. Stuff that was purely functional and honestly didn't look that bad. I'm happy to spend time saving and investing in my forever pieces, and as they come, I give away the placeholder piece that served me well. Also, this gave my Pinterest board time to breath and helped me distinguish between what I actually will love forever as opposed to me just catching onto trends.
